item: A law document's last_checked_at is no longer stamped by an attempt that made no request (a kill-switch refusal, a Crawl-delay deferral); a deferral has its own tally key and does not spend the pass's batch
refs: R293; R189; OSM C1 consent sweep; PR #1541
summary: track_document set last_checked_at before it fetched and kept the stamp when the kill switch refused the fetch or the host's Crawl-delay deferred it (CrawlDelayDeferred, ruled a deferral, not a failure, S04-13 S2 / Q1013), so a refusal that made zero requests read as a check on the law status line, the Living sources freshness, the coverage ages and the ingest report, and kept the document out of auto_track_due for 24 h (measured with the real fetcher and the switch engaged: last_checked_at = now, then due 0 once the switch cleared with the fetcher never reached; pressing Stop mid-pass stamped every remaining document of the batch). Now the previous time is given back when kill_switch_active() or the error is a CrawlDelayDeferred (the generic branch too, where the socket-level AirplaneModeError lands); last_status still names the refusal (test_law_lane_offline pins it) and OSM's offline flag and skipped_offline count compose with the restore (the restore asks the switch OR the refusal text, so a refusal is restored even after the switch was cleared), so the two fields can disagree on purpose: the time of the last real check and the outcome of the latest attempt. A real failed request, a robots disallow (cached refusals included), BlockedTarget and a malformed URL keep stamping: they are deterministic answers about the document and stamping is their back-off. A deferral returns status deferred, keeps main's 'fetch error: Crawl-delay ...' status text (so the Law table pill keeps its verdict; a 'deferred:' text would badge as 'other' until a deferred verdict and its x12 label are ruled), is not counted in the documents tally (documents = documents attempted, a refused or failed document still counts as on main; the Activity Ledger prints it as 'N document(s) read') and counts under a new tally key deferred (present only when a document was deferred, the convention of skipped_offline; not in errors) in track_watched and auto_track_due. Because a restored time leaves a deferred document at the head of the least-recently-checked order, auto_track_due now spends its batch on documents that were asked (a document whose processing raises still counts) and asks a host that defers once per pass (its host and document reads sit inside the per-document guard: a malformed URL is one error, not a dead pass) (measured: with the restore alone, three documents of one slow host filled a batch of two and the fast host got no baseline). Also EthicalFetcher._fetch_locked: a retry (attempt > 0) that meets a Crawl-delay above OO_CRAWL_DELAY_MAX_WAIT now raises the failure in hand (the 503/429 or the request error) instead of CrawlDelayDeferred, because a request WAS made and failed (measured with a real fetcher and a stub session: one request, status deferred, not stamped; the collector filed it in its deferral bucket too); a first-attempt deferral is unchanged. 16 tests in tests/test_law_check_stamp.py and 5 in tests/test_crawl_delay_retry_is_a_failure.py; 18 mutants caught (the restore decided by the switch alone or by the text alone, the host read or the document read outside the guard, the order flipped, never-checked last, a crash counted in documents, no restore in either branch, the FetchError branch decided by text, no deferral branch, restore on every failure, host not remembered, deferral spends the budget, a crash not spending the budget, no deferred key, a deferred: status text, a deferral counted in documents in either tracker). Stated: whether a law host can trigger the deferral today is not measured; the switch cleared between failure and check leaves the stamp (cautious); the app-gov-law.js toast and _verdict_of do not know the new status (a chrome string is x12 locales); a document whose processing crashes after a good fetch is re-fetched every pass on main and still is (the rollback discards its stamp).
